name: Trampled Under Foot
summary: In Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor, Orokk Omosh tests smiths with hard work. Green iron armor puts their endurance to the proof and teaches them to make heavy iron boots, while the Omosh bloodline's techniques hang in the balance.

sections.title: The Trials of Omosh
sections.body: Orokk Omosh trains armorsmiths in Orgrimmar with trials of hard physical labor. To him, metalworking is more than heating ore and shaping it. It honors his ancestral clan and tests a smith's endurance. This is the third trial in his chain, and making tempered green iron armor again and again builds muscle and discipline.

sections.title: Legacy of Chief Gorokk
sections.body: Smiths who bring Orokk the requested green iron gear win rare praise from the gruff armorsmith. He compares an artisan who endures the work to his grandfather, Chief Gorokk of Omosh. For the armor, Orokk teaches the ancestral design for sturdy iron boots. Horde warriors wear them to crush their enemies beneath their heels.

faq.q: Who offers the quest Trampled Under Foot?
faq.answer: Orokk Omosh, an orc armorsmith in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor, offers the trial.

faq.q: What does Orokk Omosh require for this trial?
faq.answer: Orokk requires four Green Iron Helms, four Green Iron Bracers, and two Green Iron Leggings. The pieces test and prove a smith's mastery of green iron craftsmanship.

faq.q: What is the lore behind the Omosh training chain?
aliases: why does orokk make you craft armor
faq.answer: Orokk Omosh puts young smiths through punishing physical labor to uphold his ancestors' martial heritage. He believes grueling armorsmithing builds the strength to make gear that can withstand brutal warfare.

faq.q: Who is Chief Gorokk of Omosh?
faq.answer: Chief Gorokk of Omosh is Orokk Omosh's grandfather. Orokk honors his grandfather's martial prowess and compares smiths who endure his heavy ironwork trials to the chieftain.

faq.q: What quest precedes Trampled Under Foot?
faq.answer: On Iron Pauldrons comes before this trial in Orokk's series of armorsmithing challenges.

faq.q: What is the next quest after completing Trampled Under Foot?
aliases: what comes after trampled under foot
faq.answer: After this trial, Orokk Omosh offers Horns of Frenzy. Joys of Omosh ends the series after the two remaining lessons.

angles.text: For a Horde armorsmith, this trial marks a major step. It calls for extensive iron smelting and green dye preparation to earn exclusive boot plans.
Orokk's lessons teach durable iron armor patterns shaped for the brutal fighting favored across Horde warfronts.
